snippet.title: Mad MOJO - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305180/Mad_MOJO/

Think Inscryption meets Pokemon.
Mad MOJO is an action-packed, monster-catching deckbuilder in disguise. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO with poker-inspired hands, real-time parries, and game-breaking elemental Tokens. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

Coming to Steam in 3Q 2026
Developed by Ceed Studio.
